prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. PHIELDWORKS equipment condition sprite sheet. Input is identity and four physical views of the extractor. Produce ONE square exact 4x4 atlas with SIXTEEN whole objects. COLUMNS are four physical ground-plane orientations: original, 90 degrees clockwise, rear 180 degrees, 270 degrees. ROWS are condition states: ROW 1 intact but electrically OFF, all LEDs black/unlit, screens black, aperture unlit, mechanisms at rest. ROW 2 lightly damaged OFF: recognizable cosmetic scuffs, one small chipped ceramic corner and a dented service cover; same intact foundation and functional mechanisms. ROW 3 severely damaged OFF: several cracked/bent/missing casing panels, exposed copper machinery, crushed cooling fins, recognizable damaged silhouette, foundation and functional core still present. ROW 4 destroyed: collapsed or broken functional head, torn casing and dark shattered ceramic on the recognizable bolted base, clearly unrecoverable until repaired, no generic identical rubble pile. ALL FOUR ROWS have NO illuminated LEDs, NO glow, NO lit apertures, NO sparks/smoke/fire and no moving parts. Different damage is GEOMETRY and SURFACE, never just a tint. Preserve exact equipment identity and material style from the reference. Camera fixed oblique overhead, verticals upright, world lighting upper left. Redraw the actual object turned on the ground; never spin or mirror the flat image. All sixteen objects wholly within their own equal square cells with 20 percent empty padding; leave clear dark gutters between every row and column. Same scale, foundation center and base height across all frames. Uniform near-black teal #101b1d background, opaque. No text, labels, cell borders, numerals or UI. Important: electrically OFF means dark glass and dark indicator recesses even for intact machinery; reflect ambient light but emit none.
